description:
Perpetual funding rates by venue and market (Binance, OKX), largest open interest in USD first. Positive funding means longs are paying to hold; negative means shorts are. Pass symbol (the base asset, e.g. BTC) and/or venue to narrow it. Results are one page: limit 1-100 (default 25), offset 0-10000; pass next_offset to get the next page. Use it when the user asks about perp funding, crowded positioning or leverage bias.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

offset.description: Pagination offset in the result units documented by the tool; zero starts the first page.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

venue.description: Exchange the perp trades on, e.g. Binance or OKX, case-insensitive.

name: get_perp_funding_rates
